As a 3rd-year CS student with a CGPA of 9.01 (which meets the requirement of CGPA 9.01 ≥ 9.00) [Policy rules checked in code] and no overdue dues (has_overdue_dues is False) [Policy rules checked in code], you are eligible for a 25% merit concession on next year's tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]. 

Your concession amount is calculated as 25% of your annual tuition fee of ₹1,45,000 [SQL]:
* 25% × ₹1,45,000 = ₹36,250

This concession of ₹36,250 will be credited against next academic year's tuition and split proportionally across the two instalments [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT f.amount AS tuition_amount, f.academic_year, s.full_name, s.cgpa, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS007') AS l WHERE l.student_id = s.student_id AND l.status = 'overdue') AS no_overdue_fees FROM (SELECT * FROM students WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS007') AS s JOIN departments AS d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN fee_structure AS f ON f.dept_id = s.dept_id AND f.year_of_study = s.year_of_study WHERE s.student_id = 'S2024CS007' AND f.component = 'tuition' AND f.academic_year = '2026-27' LIMIT 200
